about.title: Professional Profile
about.headline: AI-Native Specialist.
about.description: I architect intelligent systems and build digital products that solve real-world problems using cutting-edge AI technologies and modern development practices.

bullets: Designed and built the company's full corporate website using React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion — a dark luxury aesthetic with advanced animations and a complete product showcase.
Developed a React + Vite e-commerce storefront with Odoo ERP backend integration via n8n automation pipelines and JSON-RPC APIs.
Built an interactive product configurator web application offering 27 room combination options with real-time 3D style rendering for exhibition and client-facing use.
Deployed a complete AI voice receptionist system using Vapi.ai, handling inbound client inquiries with real-time natural language understanding and automated response routing.
Built an HR management web application integrating biometric attendance devices with Supabase backend, Cloudflare Workers middleware, and AI-powered workforce analytics dashboards.
Deployed and managed AI tools across HR, marketing, and operations — including AI-generated content pipelines, automated payroll workflows, and intelligent document processing.
Led AI-driven marketing campaigns producing cinematic brand visuals and social media content using Midjourney, Higgsfield AI, ElevenLabs, and video AI generation platforms.
Developed custom web applications and landing pages for multiple clients using React, Firebase, and modern frontend stacks — delivering responsive, performant production sites.
Provided AI consulting to SMEs on tool selection and workflow automation using Make.com, ChatGPT, and n8n, enabling measurable productivity gains.
Designed and deployed custom GPT-powered assistants and prompt engineering frameworks tailored to each client's knowledge base and operational workflows.
Created AI-assisted HR systems with biometric data integration and intelligent reporting dashboards, significantly reducing manual administrative workload.
Delivered AI literacy workshops enabling non-technical teams to effectively adopt AI tools and integrate them into daily business processes.
Systematically evaluated emerging LLMs and generative AI platforms from initial public launch, building deep institutional knowledge of capabilities, limitations, and best use cases.
Built personal automation ecosystems combining early GPT models, Zapier, and custom scripting for productivity optimization and content generation workflows.
Developed comprehensive expertise in prompt design, model behavior analysis, hallucination detection, and AI output quality evaluation methodologies.
